name: im-mcp-codeagent
description: Auto-generate controllable MCP Servers from YunOS HDT apps (Claude Code + Codex).

interface.shortDescription: Auto-generate controllable MCP Servers from YunOS HDT apps.
interface.longDescription: Scaffolds an MCP Server from a YunOS HDT app manifest, generates an adb-driven rpc-bridge, and wires a car-side RpcEngine so Claude Code and Codex can drive the device.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold an MCP server from a YunOS HDT app manifest.
Generate the rpc-bridge and car-side RpcEngine wiring.
